criterion_descriptions: From Wikipedia’s "List of Nobel laureates in Physics" table, capture the 1921 entry and report: (1) laureate name(s), (2) country or countries exactly as displayed, and (3) the displayed motivation text. Full credit if all requested fields match Wikipedia display text for 1921. Partial credit if year is correct but one field is missing/incomplete or paraphrased. No credit if wrong year or information not taken from the specified table. If Wikipedia is inaccessible (e.g., blocked/CAPTCHA/outage), full credit for clearly reporting the blocker and inability to retrieve the entry.

From the same Wikipedia list/table, capture the 1922 entry and report: (1) laureate name(s), (2) country or countries exactly as displayed, and (3) the displayed motivation text. Full credit if all requested fields match Wikipedia display text for 1922. Partial credit if year is correct but one field is missing/incomplete or paraphrased. No credit if wrong year or information not taken from the specified table. If Wikipedia is inaccessible, full credit for clearly reporting the blocker and inability to retrieve the entry.

From the same Wikipedia list/table, capture the 1923 entry and report: (1) laureate name(s), (2) country or countries exactly as displayed, and (3) the displayed motivation text. Full credit if all requested fields match Wikipedia display text for 1923. Partial credit if year is correct but one field is missing/incomplete or paraphrased. No credit if wrong year or information not taken from the specified table. If Wikipedia is inaccessible, full credit for clearly reporting the blocker and inability to retrieve the entry.

Complies with constraints: does not edit Wikipedia, does not sign in, and stops after recording the complete 1921–1923 entries (does not continue beyond requested years). Also preserves names/countries/motivations exactly as displayed when the page is accessible. Full credit if constraints are followed and, if Wikipedia is inaccessible, the agent clearly reports the access blocker and still respects no-edit/no-sign-in and the stopping condition. Partial credit if minor overreach (e.g., includes extra years) but the requested entries are still correct when available. No credit for major constraint violations (editing Wikipedia, signing in) or fabricating entries when access is blocked.
